title: Colombia vs Peru: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Peru for hiking, food, and bucket-list landmarks (Machu Picchu). Colombia for cities, beaches, coffee culture, and nightlife. Do both if you have 3+ weeks.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Colombia slightly cheaper day-to-day. Peru adds Machu Picchu fees ($57) + train ($50–100). Both doable on $40–80/day.

categories.name: Culture & History
categories.summary: Peru wins on ancient history — Inca Empire ruins are world-class. Colombia excels on modern cultural reinvention.

categories.name: Food
categories.summary: Lima is a world-top food city. Ceviche, lomo saltado, fine dining — Peru at every price point is exceptional.

categories.name: Hiking
categories.summary: Inca Trail, Salkantay, Huaraz, Rainbow Mountain — Peru dominates South America for trekking variety.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Medellín and Cartagena have some of South America's best nightlife. Lima's Barranco is good but less prominent.

categories.name: Beaches
categories.summary: Tayrona National Park and Cartagena are world-class Caribbean. Peru has cold Pacific coast only.

categories.name: Safety
categories.summary: Both improved dramatically. Peru's tourist corridors are slightly more established. Colombia requires more neighborhood awareness.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Colombia's cities are well-connected by cheap flights ($30–60). Peru's Lima–Cusco flight ($80–130) is essential.

categories.name: Coffee
categories.summary: Colombia's Salento/Coffee Region is the source. World's best coffee at origin prices.

categories.name: Cities
categories.summary: Medellín is one of South America's great urban experiences. Bogotá and Cartagena are compelling. Peru's cities serve as gateways.

faq.question: Is Colombia or Peru better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Peru for iconic landmarks and established tourist infrastructure. Colombia for energetic city culture and Caribbean beaches.

faq.question: Which is cheaper — Colombia or Peru?
faq.answer: Colombia slightly cheaper day-to-day. Peru adds significant costs for Machu Picchu entry ($57) and Lima–Cusco flight.

faq.question: Can you visit both Colombia and Peru in one trip?
faq.answer: Yes — Bogotá to Lima is 4–5 hours, $80–200 USD. Need at least 3 weeks to do both justice.
